source_policy.source_note: Uses legacy content_pool transcripts with unverified provenance as simulated training material. Do not label as true exam content.

front.text: 听完后，判断 more importantly 后的信息起什么作用。
front.task_prompt: more importantly 往往把后句抬到更高权重；不要把它当普通 and。

task_schema.action: 选择递进后的信息作用
task_schema.focus: more importantly 引出的权重升级
task_schema.success_criteria: 能说明递进标记后的后句比前句评价权重更高

options.text: It only repeats that the report is useful.
It raises the point to budget-setting impact.
It says the report is no longer useful.
It changes the topic to next year's schedule.

audio.transcript: The report is useful, and more importantly, it changes how we set next year's budget.

analysis.text: 正确答案是 B。useful 只是一般评价，and more importantly 后面的 changes how we set next year's budget 把信息推进到决策影响层。并列/递进题里，and 不一定只表示同层补充；more importantly 明确提示后句权重更高。A 忽略了加码，C 与原句相反，D 把 budget setting 误读成普通日程安排。
tips: 听到 more importantly，优先检查后句是不是主结论层。
不要只按 and 判断并列，要看后面有没有权重升级词。

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 识别 more importantly 引出的递进加码

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 训练用户在听力里识别递进标记后的高权重信息，避免把 more importantly 当作普通补充。

front.text: 听完后，选出 besides 后真正新增的信息。
front.task_prompt: besides 后常补一个新维度；题目问新增点时，只核对信号词后的具体信息，不回选前句概括。

task_schema.action: 选择递进后的新增信息
task_schema.success_criteria: 能区分前句概括和信号词后的具体补充

options.text: The software is popular among interns.
The software saves time in general.
Staff training time is reduced from one month to two weeks.

audio.transcript: The software saves time; besides, it shortens staff training from a month to two weeks.

analysis.text: 正确答案是 C。The software saves time 是前半句的泛化收益；besides 后的 it shortens staff training from a month to two weeks 才是新增的量化加码信息。递进题常用前半句关键词做干扰项，诱导你回选已经出现过的宽泛评价。A、D 没有依据，B 只复述前句，不是 besides 后的新信息。
tips: besides 后若出现数字、时间或范围变化，通常是新增证据。
题目问新增点时，不要选前半句已经说过的泛化收益。

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 识别 besides 后的新增量化信息

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 帮助用户把递进后的数字和范围变化识别为真正新增证据，而不是停留在前句泛化收益。

front.text: 听到 moreover 后，判断它后面新增了哪一层信息。
front.task_prompt: moreover 后面给追加维度；题目问新增点时，先排除前句已说过的信息。

task_schema.action: 选择 moreover 后新增信息
task_schema.success_criteria: 能区分前句已给信息和信号词后的新增维度

options.text: It improves indoor comfort during winter.
The plan will be canceled in winter.
It makes energy use higher than before.

audio.transcript: The plan lowers energy use. Moreover, it improves indoor comfort during winter.

analysis.text: 正确答案是 B。The plan lowers energy use 是前句已经给出的收益；moreover 后的 it improves indoor comfort during winter 才是追加收益。moreover 常把信息继续往前推，但考点不一定是“更强”，也可能是“新增维度”。A 是前句信息，C 没有依据，D 与 lowers energy use 冲突。
tips: 听到 moreover，先问：后面新增了哪个维度？
不要把前句已出现的 benefit 当作递进后的答案。

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 识别 moreover 后的新增收益维度

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 训练用户听到 moreover 后抓新增维度，避免被前句 already-mentioned benefit 带回去。
